tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_winter_wyvern_winte: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units. Enemy heroes which enter the cursed area after the cast add to the duration of the curse.
The oldest of the bookwurm's spells, this curse lends truth to the old saw: sometimes the enemy of my enemy is my enemy still.
If the target dies to its allies, Winter Wyvern will receive credit for the kill.
Will only pierce the spell immunity of the primary target, not the target's surrounding allies.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_winter_wyvern_bio: Like many great poets, Auroth just wants time to write, but the Winter Wyvern's life is full of interruptions. The epics of the Eldwurms have a long and colorful history, but some fear that the remaining dragon scholars are not as prolific as they once were, with few lines added to the Eldwurm Eddas since the last age of greatness. Auroth laments: "We forget that there is more to life than triumph and dominion over enemies. We must also live our lives in the pursuit of creative expression." She embarks on research expeditions, collecting books for inspiration. But all this research can be terribly distracting, and she spends less time writing than she should. Although she knows she should be lurking in her lair, adding to the Eddas, she finds herself engaged in epic battles against powerful enemies. She loots castles, raids ancient libraries ... and if she happens to heap glory on herself in the process, she tells herself that it's merely a side effect of her research. The fact is, while her skill and power on the battlefield are legendary, her scholarly travails have thus far hardly been the stuff of literary acclaim. But she is not content to stand as a protagonist of heroic lore. She wishes also to create it.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** {{Symbol|Channeling}}
*** Interrupts Auroth's [[channeling]] abilities upon cast.
**** {{cf|aghnotes}} No longer interrupts channeling abilities upon acquiring the {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}}.
** Grants the following bonuses upon cast:
*** {{M|Flying movement}}, but not {{M|flying vision}}.
*** Bonus {{M|attack range}} based on the caster's attack range type.
** {{Symbol|Trees}}
*** [[Trees]] within a {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} 175 unit radius are destroyed at the end of the duration while Auroth is landing.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** The ability effects are applied as follows:
**# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|winter_wyvern_arctic_burn_slow}}
**#* This ability component relies on attack [[projectiles]] for the debuff application. Hence {{M|melee}} heroes cannot apply the debuff.
**#* Leveling up the ability immediately updates the next applied debuff values, but does not interact with the damage intervals.
**#* {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**#** Each successful attack now places an independent debuff on the affected enemy unit.
**#* Does not affect the following units:
**#** {{M|Allied units|x}}.
**#** {{M|Buildings}}
**#** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
**#* Deals {{Code|{{calc|v1*{{#var:Arctic Burn basic1}}|v1={{#var:Arctic Burn type1 value1}}|%}} × Current[[Health|HP]]}} {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} in {{#var:Arctic Burn basic1}}-second intervals, starting {{#var:Arctic Burn basic1}} seconds upon debuff application, resulting in {{#expr:{{#var:Arctic Burn type1 value3}}/{{#var:Arctic Burn basic1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t2r}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Arctic Burn type1 value3 tal}}/{{#var:Arctic Burn basic1}}}}|15tal}}) damage instances.
**#** The {{M|current health}} as damage component is lethal.
**# Auroth's attack instance.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Turns Arctic Burn into a [[toggle]] ability.
** {{Symbol|Toggle|On}}
*** Arctic Burn continues working while being affected by the following sources:
**** {{M|Disable}} sources.
**** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
**** {{M|Silence}} sources.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_winter_wyvern
data.bio_loc: Like many great poets, Auroth just wants time to write, but the Winter Wyvern's life is full of interruptions. The epics of the Eldwurms have a long and colorful history, but some fear that the remaining dragon scholars are not as prolific as they once were, with few lines added to the Eldwurm Eddas since the last age of greatness. Auroth laments: "We forget that there is more to life than triumph and dominion over enemies. We must also live our lives in the pursuit of creative expression." She embarks on research expeditions, collecting books for inspiration. But all this research can be terribly distracting, and she spends less time writing than she should. Although she knows she should be lurking in her lair, adding to the Eddas, she finds herself engaged in epic battles against powerful enemies. She loots castles, raids ancient libraries ... and if she happens to heap glory on herself in the process, she tells herself that it's merely a side effect of her research. The fact is, while her skill and power on the battlefield are legendary, her scholarly travails have thus far hardly been the stuff of literary acclaim. But she is not content to stand as a protagonist of heroic lore. She wishes also to create it.
data.hype_loc: Winter Wyvern stalks the skies, slowing foes with burning cold as she soars over the battlefield. Should the enemy be foolish enough to gather, she curses them to attack one of their own as she blasts the gathering with icy splinters.
data.npe_desc_loc: Able to force her enemies to attack their own ally

abilities.name: winter_wyvern_arctic_burn
abilities.desc_loc: Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of %percent_damage%%% of their current health each second.
abilities.lore_loc: The same organ where some dragons stoke their inner flame is, in Auroth, a crucible of unimaginable cold. From deep within her frosty gullet, an exhalation sends enemies into burning agony.
notes_loc: This ability does not affect Roshan.
Reduces Winter Wyvern's attack point to %attack_point%.
The damage and slow from Arctic Burn can be dispelled.
abilities.scepter_loc: Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.

abilities.name: winter_wyvern_splinter_blast
abilities.desc_loc: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a %split_radius% base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by %movespeed_slow_tooltip%%%.
abilities.lore_loc: Produced slowly by specialized vesicles in her frozen gullet, Winter Wyvern blast shards of ice at her enemies.
notes_loc: The primary projectile moves at %projectile_speed% movement speed.
The primary projectile cannot be disjointed and cannot be targeted towards Winter Wyvern herself.

abilities.name: winter_wyvern_cold_embrace
abilities.desc_loc: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
abilities.lore_loc: From winter's heart comes a cold, healing embrace. The ice slows the blood and allows the spell to better work its curative magic.
abilities.shard_loc: Reduces cooldown by %shard_cooldown_reduction% seconds. Allied units gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon.
facets_loc: Cold Embrace can be cast on buildings. Does not heal buildings. Allied units and buildings gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon. Duration is paused if the building is protected by both Glyph of Fortification and Cold Embrace.

abilities.name: winter_wyvern_eldwurms_edda
abilities.desc_loc: Grants Winter Wyvern the item Eldwurm's Edda, which can be consumed to increase the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one and Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by %tooltip_int_pct%%% of its current value at the time of consumption.

abilities.name: winter_wyvern_winters_curse
abilities.desc_loc: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units. Enemy heroes which enter the cursed area after the cast add to the duration of the curse.
abilities.lore_loc: The oldest of the bookwurm's spells, this curse lends truth to the old saw: sometimes the enemy of my enemy is my enemy still.
notes_loc: If the target dies to its allies, Winter Wyvern will receive credit for the kill.
Will only pierce the spell immunity of the primary target, not the target's surrounding allies.
